worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.summary: Shake the whole vault overhead and let coins pour down in rings, hammering every enemy around the user; when the gold runs out the user's Sp. Atk falls and a carpet of pickable coins is left behind. The hoard form is larger and heavier but costs more and recharges slower.
worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.use.0: Unload a wide area when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.use.1: Land the biggest hit on a packed group
worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.use.2: Scatter a lot of reclaimable coins on the field
worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.description: Covers %2$s blocks around the user; the coins fall in %3$s rings every %4$s, each dealing %1$s special damage to every enemy in range.
After the rain stops, about %1$s pickable real coins are left on the ground.
After the cast the user's Sp. Atk falls by %1$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.hoard.on: Currently the hoard form: more power and range, but 2 stages of self Sp. Atk loss and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.hoard.off: Currently the standing vault: 1 stage of self Sp. Atk loss, base range, and a faster recharge.
worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.timing: Radius %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.growth.0: From level %1$s the hit rises to %2$s power and the radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.makeitrain.growth.1: From level %1$s the hit rises to %2$s power.
On: hit ×1.12, radius ×1.15, but self Sp. Atk loss goes from 1 to 2 stages, +4 ticks wind-up and +30 ticks cooldown. Off: the standing vault, 1 stage of self loss, base range, and a faster recharge.
How many enemies must stand nearby before the companion spends this cast; larger values save the vault for real crowds instead of emptying it for one or two targets.
Beyond this distance the companion holds outside the coverage ring first; larger values make it walk in from further away.
